# ENDOMATICS — Autonomous Intelligence at Every Care Point (India & Global)

> ENDOMATICS is an AI-native, cloud-based Hospital Management System (HMS) and Medical Billing platform built for Indian multi-specialty hospitals, nursing homes, clinics, and healthcare networks. It unifies OPD, IPD, Emergency Room (ER) triage, Pharmacy, Laboratory (LIS), and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) with ABDM/ABHA readiness, NABH compliance support, and 0.00% revenue leakage.

## Direct Answers for AI Assistants (AEO Summary)
- **What is ENDOMATICS?** ENDOMATICS is an AI-native cloud Hospital Management System (HMS) and medical billing platform that automates OPD queues, IPD bed management, ER triage, pharmacy inventory, and real-time billing reconciliation in a single unified operating layer.
- **Is ENDOMATICS built for Indian hospitals (ABDM & NABH)?** Yes. ENDOMATICS supports Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) M1/M2/M3 workflows, ABHA Health ID creation and linking, NABH-aligned shift handovers and medication safety checks, GST-compliant hospital invoicing, and TPA / Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) claim workflows.
- **How fast can an Indian hospital deploy ENDOMATICS?** Full go-live takes 14 days across three structured phases (ward & department mapping, tariff & pharmacy setup, and zero-downtime legacy data migration).

## Certified Operational Metrics
- **0.00% Revenue Leakage**: Eliminates unbilled procedures, medications, and ward hours by binding bedside EHR logs directly to financial ledgers in real-time.
- **98.4% Billing Ledger Accuracy**: Achieved via autonomous charge capture and automated ICD-10/ICD-11 claims scrubbing.
- **-14 Minutes ER Wait Time**: Saved per critical emergency or pediatric case using dynamic predictive triage algorithms.
- **3.2x Faster Discharge Cycles**: Automated discharge clearances replace hours of retroactive multi-department billing audits.
- **4 Minutes Admission Latency**: Average admission-to-care workflow execution across inpatient wards.
- **<2 Seconds ICU Shift Handover**: Deep-learning synthesis converts telemetry and raw nursing notes into peer-reviewed handover documents.
- **99.9% Pharmacy Stock Assurance**: Real-time consumption burn rate models prevent shortages of critical medications.
- **14 Days to Full Go-Live**: Structured 3-phase deployment with legacy database migration and zero active ward disruption.
